title: Valera Nattokinase (150-Day Supply)
description: Valera Nattokinase is an enteric-coated softgel dietary supplement containing nattokinase, vitamin K2, coenzyme Q10, turmeric extract, olive extract, and bromelain. Each 3-softgel serving provides 500 mg of nattokinase with 10,800 FU activity. Take 3 softgels once daily with a glass of water on an empty stomach. Product Details: Product Type: Dietary Supplement Brand: Valera Supplement Form: Enteric-Coated Softgels Serving Size: 3 Softgels Nattokinase: 500 mg per serving Nattokinase Activity: 10,800 FU per serving Vitamin K2: 100 mcg per serving Coenzyme Q10: 100 mg per serving Turmeric Extract: 50 mg per serving Olive Extract: 10 mg per serving Bromelain: 10 mg per serving Bromelain Activity: 2,400 GDU per gram Carrier Oil: MCT Oil from Coconut Oil Other Ingredients: Gelatin, Glycerin, Purified Water, Yellow Beeswax Allergen Information: Contains Soy and Tree Nuts including Coconut Dietary Information: Does not contain Wheat, Dairy, or Gluten Suggested Use: Take 3 softgels once daily with a glass of water upon waking. Take on an empty stomach. Storage: Store refrigerated. Warning: If you currently take a blood thinner, speak with your doctor before starting. Discontinue use two weeks before any scheduled surgery. Keep out of reach of children.
